meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: Claude 会拉取项目全部 claude-mem 历史,先估算并确认 token,再让子代理写一份 3000–6000 词的《Journey Into [项目名]》叙事报告,涵盖起源、演进、突破、技术债等,存为 markdown 并告知位置与成本。
howto.when: 当你要求“时间线报告”“项目历史分析”或“开发历程”等时;若说“这个项目”,默认用当前目录名。需 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目已有记录。

say.text: 给 tokyo 项目写一份时间线报告
say.note: 会先取回该项目时间线并报告 token 估算,确认后再生成。

say.text: 分析一下当前项目的完整开发历史

howto.what_en: Claude pulls a project's full claude-mem history, asks confirmation after estimating token cost, writes a 3k-6k-word 'Journey Into [Project]' narrative covering origin, evolution, breakthroughs, tech debt, saves as markdown and reports path/cost.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'timeline report', 'project history analysis', 'development journey', etc.; 'this project' uses current directory name. Needs claude-mem worker running and observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for the tokyo project.
say_en.note: It fetches the timeline and asks to confirm the token estimate first.

say_en.text: Analyze the full development history of the current project.
say_en.note: In a git worktree it uses the parent project as data source.

say_en.text: Write a Journey Into my-app report and save it to docs/journey.md.
say_en.note: A custom output path overrides the default file location.
